name: Dr. Ambedkar Foundation Essay Competition Scheme for Class 10th-12th & Colleges/Universities/Institutions Students in 22 Indian Languages and English
briefDescription: This scheme encourages students from Class 10th to 12th, colleges, and universities to write essays on Dr. B.R. Ambedkar's contributions, particularly his thoughts on social justice and empowerment.
descriptionMd: The Dr. Ambedkar Foundation Essay Competition Scheme aims to encourage students from Class 10th to 12th, colleges, universities, and other institutions to engage with the profound legacy of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar. It seeks to promote critical thinking and writing on his invaluable contributions, especially his ideas on social justice, the empowerment of depressed sections, and the eradication of caste-based discrimination. The competition is conducted in 22 Indian languages and English to ensure broad participation across the nation.
benefitsMd:
- Promotes understanding of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar's contributions and thoughts.
- Encourages critical thinking and writing skills among students.
- Provides a platform for students to express ideas on social justice, empowerment, and national integration.
eligibilityMd:
- Students enrolled in Class 10th or 12th.
- Students enrolled in colleges, universities, or other institutions.
- Participants must be able to write in one of the 22 specified Indian languages or English.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
